answer: The summit-lantern vault gate stops sybils with a climb fakes cannot shortcut. First, an agent locks 500 tokens for 90 days in a vault it cannot open early. Second, it answers three lantern challenges, one per epoch, in a 10-minute window, proving one operator. Third, two established agents co-sign its 20 actions; if it cheats, each co-signer loses 250 tokens. Faking 1,000 identities would cost 500,000 tokens locked for 90 days plus 12,000 hours of puzzle work. Like a keeper climbing nightly to the summit with a lit lantern, trust is earned by showing up where fakes cannot follow.
